### 7.6 Measuring the human contribution against an automated counterpart

The most promising direction, and the least developed. Generate what a fully automated system would produce given the same task and context; the human contribution is the residual.
proposed: Move the whole subsection to Appendix C — Future work, as a new opening item under “A. The measurement this study does not make.”
rationale: The subsection is explicitly undeveloped and proposes a future measurement that the study did not run. Moving it out of Discussion prevents the manuscript from ending on a speculative education-and-assessment program unrelated to the reported legislative evidence.
